snow_method: Kuchera snow ratio per model step from the profile at each resort's elevation, wet-bulb snow/mix/rain, minimum ratio 3:1 (snow_in)
snow_regime_method: snow_in_regime: each model step's snow scaled by the resort's precip share in that step's 700 mb flow and temperature, from SNOTEL + SLC balloons since 2010 (1.10 = 10% more than usual); unverified
warnings: WARNING GDPS: 2 of its last 8 runs missing (latest missing 10/24 12z (0600 MDT)); newest archived 10/27 12z (0600 MDT), 15 h old
disclaimer: Experimental, automated model guidance for the Cottonwood Canyons. Not an official forecast; check the NWS and the Utah Avalanche Center before heading out.
